readings.title: Efficient algorithms for quantum information bottleneck
readings.identity_evidence: p1 Hayashi/Yang title/authors; footer arXiv2208.10342v2 25Feb2023, Quantum accepted21Feb2023. p10 Lemmas6-7/Eq52-55 visually inspected.
read_scope: pp1-3: problem definition, cq channel and objective; not full convergence proof.
p10: uniform-source fixed-dimension quantum/classical optimum Lemmas6-7.
pp11-12: HS-kernel classifier/access and noisy synthetic experiment description.
findings: p2 Eq1-3 allows classical X and quantum or diagonal classical Y; classical labels are an allowed special case, so a quantum relevance variable is not mandatory.
p10 Lemmas6-7 compare entropic objective values at fixed memory dimension. Their pure-state frame differs from a classical probability simplex.
p11 Eq60-62 uses quantum-state/Hilbert-Schmidt kernel features; p12 source-reported synthetic classification is not a one-copy POVM or the relation benchmark.

Specializing to uniform3labels/qubit gives a strict QIB-objective advantage while the one-copy best classification accuracy equals the classical-bit optimum2/3. That last operational comparison is our analytic application of standard dimension bounds, not claimed novelty or a source experiment.
limitations: No source code, reproduced experiments, complete convergence proof or current-field priority audit.
pp4,6-9 text was inspected/previewed but not a certified convergence proof; remaining appendices and sufficiency-statistic example not audited.
No loss or optimizer adopted for the native head.

readings.title: Convexity and Operational Interpretation of the Quantum Information Bottleneck Function
readings.identity_evidence: p1 Datta/Hirche/Winter title/authors; footer arXiv1810.03644v3 22Mar2019. p3 conditional source-coding setup/Fig2 visually inspected.
read_scope: p2: Eq4/channel definition and operational context.
pp3-4: flagged-channel convexity argument and quantum WAK protocol/conditions; no complete coding proof audit.
findings: p2 Eq4 optimizes over CPTP encoders, not the native low-depth pure-state parameter family.
pp3-4 coding interpretation uses asymptotic iid source, shared entanglement, helper/decoder side information, quantum rates and a reconstruction-fidelity criterion.
Neither that operational coding theorem nor convexity alone yields relation-classification improvement, a fixed-memory convergence certificate or a task-specific readout mechanism.
limitations: No appendix/full source-coding proof, code, experimental reproduction or priority audit.
Displayed/extracted equations are not transplanted as algorithm or rate bounds.

discovery.scope: Bounded arXiv metadata/abstract search, not exhaustive. Luders keyword mostly returned names/unrelated papers, so no measurement-original priority claim.

independent_ideation_originals: Metadata/abstracts only in that pass; host later read selected originals. Review tasks stay separate.
